whatIs: Bolt is an AI builder that generates websites, apps, prototypes and presentations from a text description. You can also start from a Figma design, a GitHub repository or a team template. With Bolt Cloud you also get hosting, databases, user authentication and custom domains.
It's a good choice for quickly reaching a working prototype or an MVP without setting up the environment, and then continuing to iterate on the code in GitHub.
uses: Spinning up an MVP with login and a database from a description.
Turning a Figma design into a web app you can edit and publish.
Creating a prototype to validate an idea with a client before writing any code by hand.
caveats: You pay by tokens: large projects or long iterations use up the free plan's quota quickly.
The GitHub integration stays linked to the main branch, and you can't change the project's branch in Bolt.
Review the generated code before going to production, especially authentication and data access.
pricingNote: Free plan with 300K tokens a day and 1M a month; the Pro plan costs $25 a month.
idealFor: Quick prototypes and MVPs that you then continue in GitHub.
